description: The plot illustrates the relationship between s_pop frequency and accuracy, comparing two different lines. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 19, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line with circle markers represents one set of data, starting at approximately 0.85 accuracy at an s_pop frequency of 1 x 10^4, increasing to around 0.95 at 3 x 10^4, remaining relatively stable until 11 x 10^4, then decreasing to about 0.8 at 13 x 10^4 before rising to 1.0 at 17 x 10^4 and remaining steady. The green solid line with square markers represents another set of data, beginning at around 0.35 accuracy at 1 x 10^4, increasing to approximately 0.65 at 7 x 10^4, then fluctuating between 0.4 and 0.65 until 15 x 10^4, before sharply rising to 1.0 at 17 x 10^4 and remaining constant. Both lines have error bars indicating the range of accuracy values.
